talking_points: **Network-adequacy risk:** 16 solo primary-care physicians (age ~66+) in Hawaii are actively winding down, and 3 ZIP code(s) already have 2+ winding down at once — including Honolulu (96817), Waipahu (96797), Ewa Beach (96706) — each a 12-month access-gap risk under Medicare Advantage and state drive-time standards.

**Facility-fee shield:** ~1,049 Medicare patients are attached to these winding-down practices today. If they drift into hospital-owned clinics, the plan pays 2-3x more per identical visit via facility fees. Corner NPs capture those panels at 85-95% of the physician fee schedule — a direct cost-containment shield.

**Immediate ask:** fast-track credentialing for Corner in Hawaii; 5 practice(s) are the highest priority (winding down with little local backup) and ~105,600 patients sit across all 88 at-risk solo practices statewide.
